# Lines layout fixes of fix/lines97. Compare the branch with main by running it twice.
# Run: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch or commit> -f script=.github/checks/lines-fixes.txt
#
# 1 (lines-intro, lines-rise_*): the demo song's first line comes at 2 s, too soon for the little notes. Before it the
#   first line should wait dim one row BELOW the middle (main: dim in the middle), and the Rise burst should take it
#   straight up (main: it drops about a row in the first frames, then rises back).
# 2 (lines-closing-*): the demo song ends with an empty line at 1:14 (a closing pause). With the timing moved 5 s on,
#   -before shows the notes and "Sing it back to me from where you are" above them; -after (about a second past the
#   fade) should be empty sky (main: both still up).
# 3 (lines-outro-*): test lines every 20 s, the last at 1:00. -sung shows it with the line before above it; -after
#   (10 s later) should be empty sky (main: "Third test line" still up, faint, at the top).
# 4 (lines-size3-*): Size 3 at the test game's FOV. Each row should fit across the screen with room at both sides
#   (main: the rows run off the left and right edges).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout LINES
set animation RISE
look 0 -22
sleep 6

# 1: the first line, before and as it starts
seek 0
sleep 0.5
shot lines-intro
burstat lines-rise 12 40
wait burst lines-rise wrote

# 2: a closing pause, while it shows and after it has been over for a while
set syncOffsetMs 5000
seek 70.5
sleep 1
where
shot lines-closing-before
seek 75.5
sleep 1
where
shot lines-closing-after
set syncOffsetMs 0

# 3: the last line of test lyrics, and the outro after it
fastlines 20000 First test line | Second test line | Third test line
seek 62
sleep 2
where
shot lines-outro-sung
seek 72
sleep 2
where
shot lines-outro-after

# 4: Size 3, only the line being sung
set showPrevious false
set showNext false
set size 3
lines Every quiet hill is glowing tonight | Lanterns drifting over the sleepy town below us all night long
seek 1
sleep 2
shot lines-size3-short
seek 5
sleep 2
shot lines-size3-long
